title_en: Fall 2026 Application for Recognition of SNU Graduate Credits Earned Before Admission
summary: Graduate students who wish to have credits recognised from graduate courses they took at Seoul National University (SNU) before their current admission may apply. They must submit the application form (Attachment 01) and a personal transcript with the requested courses marked to the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319) by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026. After the university headquarters processes the paper application, students must complete an online system application as separately instructed.
applies_to: Graduate students who wish to have recognised the course credits they earned at the SNU graduate school before admission to their current SNU master's or doctoral program. Only credits from master's or doctoral courses in the same or a similar major are eligible. Application is voluntary, but students are asked to apply in their first semester after admission.

dates.what: Deadline to submit the paper application form and marked transcript to the Department Administrative Office

conditions: Students are asked to apply in their first semester after admission, for smooth academic administration.
Only course credits earned in a master's or doctoral program in the same or a similar major at the SNU graduate school before admission can be recognised.
Courses from an undergraduate (bachelor's) program cannot be submitted for recognition.
The application form must be submitted together with a personal transcript on which the requested courses are marked.
The paper application must be submitted first; the system application can only be made after headquarters processing and according to separate guidance.
Previous master's program to current master's program or integrated master's-doctoral program: up to 12 credits may be recognised.
Previous doctoral program to current doctoral program or integrated master's-doctoral program: up to 18 credits may be recognised.
Previous integrated master's-doctoral program to current master's program: up to 12 credits may be recognised.
Previous integrated master's-doctoral program to current integrated master's-doctoral program: up to 18 credits may be recognised.

Previous integrated master's-doctoral program to current doctoral program: up to 18 credits, but only if the student completed coursework (수료) in the integrated master's-doctoral program of the same or a similar department or major at SNU before entering the doctoral program.
steps: Read the attached application form (Attachment 01: 입학전 본교 신청서(학생용)_2026-2.hwp); its content was not read for this translation.
Complete the application form and obtain your personal transcript, marking on it the courses for which you are requesting recognition.
Submit the application form and the marked transcript to the staff member in the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319) by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026.
After headquarters has processed your paper application, complete the application in the online system following the separate guidance you will receive.
For questions, contact the Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319); the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 Application for Recognition of Credits Earned at the Same University (SNU) Graduate School Before Admission

1. Who may apply
Graduate students who wish to have recognised the credits they earned at the same university's (SNU) graduate school before their admission to this university.
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission.

2. Submission of application documents
a. Period: until 5:00 p.m., Monday, 21 September 2026 (~ 2026. 9. 21.(월) 오후 5시까지)
b. Submit the application documents to the staff member in charge at the Department Administrative Office [학부행정실] (Building 301, Room 319).
c. Application documents: see the attachment (Attachment 01).
※ Please submit the application form together with your personal transcript, with the courses you are applying for marked.
※ Because your previous student ID number and department information must be linked, submit the paper application form first; after headquarters has processed it, complete the application in the system according to separate guidance.

3. Recognition of earned credits
a. Applications for credit recognition are possible only for course credits earned in a master's or doctoral program in the same or a similar major at the same university's (SNU) graduate school before admission to this university's master's or doctoral program.
※ Undergraduate (bachelor's) program courses: cannot be applied for.

b. Credits that can be recognised (program before admission | current program | recognised credits):
- Master's program | Master's program | up to 12 credits
- Master's program | Integrated master's-doctoral program | up to 12 credits
- Doctoral program | Doctoral program | up to 18 credits
- Doctoral program | Integrated master's-doctoral program | up to 18 credits
- Integrated master's-doctoral program | Master's program | up to 12 credits
- Integrated master's-doctoral program | Doctoral program* | up to 18 credits
- Integrated master's-doctoral program | Integrated master's-doctoral program | up to 18 credits
* However, this applies only if, before entering the doctoral program, the student completed coursework (수료) in the integrated master's-doctoral program of the same or a similar department or major at this university.

- Please refer to the attachment.
- Inquiries: Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachment (1 file): [Attachment 01] 입학전 본교 신청서(학생용)_2026-2.hwp (Application form for credits earned at this university before admission, student version), 37 KB. The content of this attachment was not read.
